vb_textbox.text: You will be shown two gnomes, one purple and one brown and then one red and one green. The purple and red work together, as do the green and brown. If you initially choose the purple or red ones and they return a high mushroom yield, continue to choose them until the yield drops to 3 or below. At this point, switch to choosing brown/green. Similarly, continue clicking on the green and brown until the yield drops to three and then switch back to choosing red and purple. If you continue this pattern throughout then you will get a high number of mushrooms.
